public_comments.comment_text: Hand-picked by Judge Richard Fisher. Refuses to review my evidence. Believes all allegations against me. Won't allow me to choose my own reintegration therapist — required to use his buddy Naomi Catadella. I lost my kids to the REAL abuser and Andy Bolton and Richard Fisher painted me as crazy, took my voice.
